title: Safety Zone; Monongahela River, Pittsburgh, PA
abstract: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters on the Monongahela River from Mile Marker 15 to Mile Marker 16. This safety zone is necessary to protect personnel and vessels from potential hazards on navigable waters during an operation to install aerial transverse wirelines. Entry of vessels or persons into this zone is prohibited unless specifically authorized by the Captain of the Port, Marine Safety Unit Pittsburgh or their designated representative or their designated representative.

abstract: The Coast Guard is establishing a temporary safety zone for navigable waters of the Huron River within a 150-yard radius of 41[deg]23'34.6" N, 82[deg]33'07.7" W in Huron, OH.
